questions.q: In which year did Hal Jordan first appear as Green Lantern, in Showcase #22?
questions.why: Hal Jordan debuted in Showcase #22, cover-dated October 1959, as a modern reinvention of the Golden Age Green Lantern.

questions.q: Which writer and artist created Hal Jordan?
questions.why: John Broome wrote and Gil Kane drew Hal in 1959, at editor Julius Schwartz's request.

questions.q: What is Hal Jordan's day job in his civilian life?
questions.why: Hal is a former fighter pilot who works as a test pilot for Ferris Aircraft.

questions.q: What does Hal Jordan's power ring turn into energy constructs?
questions.why: The Green Lantern ring channels willpower into glowing constructs, and Hal is known for his exceptional willpower.

questions.q: Which woman is Hal's on-again, off-again love interest, who has sometimes become Star Sapphire?
questions.why: Carol Ferris, who is connected to Ferris Aircraft, has been his main love interest and at times his enemy as Star Sapphire.

questions.q: Which Hollywood actor was the artist's visual inspiration for Hal Jordan?
questions.why: Kane drew Hal with the looks of Paul Newman, unlike the folklore-inspired Alan Scott.

questions.q: Which alien tyrant destroyed Coast City in 1993, pushing Hal toward becoming Parallax?
questions.why: During Reign of the Supermen, Mongul destroyed Hal's hometown, and the loss led to Hal's turn as Parallax.

questions.q: In the 1999 miniseries Day of Judgment, Hal Jordan becomes the newest incarnation of which cosmic being?
questions.why: After his turn as Parallax, Hal became the Spectre, an agent of God's wrath, in Day of Judgment.

questions.q: Who played Hal Jordan in the 2011 film Green Lantern?
questions.why: Ryan Reynolds starred as the test pilot in Martin Campbell's film, the character's cinematic debut.

questions.q: Which actor voices Hal Jordan in Justice League: Doom and Green Lantern: Emerald Knights?
questions.why: Nathan Fillion voiced Hal in several DC animated films, including Emerald Knights and Justice League: Doom.
